title: Anthropic Removes 5 Hour Usage Limit for New $200 Claude Ultra Plan
summary:
The creator of the Claude AI assistant is updating its subscription structure to clear up confusion over how usage caps are calculated for its most expensive offerings. The company is rebranding its Max 5x plan as Max and its Max 20x plan as Ultra, maintaining the monthly costs of $100 and $200, respectively. As part of the change, verified users on the new Ultra tier will no longer be subject to a 5 hour limit on their usage sessions.

The update aims to resolve a branding issue where users believed the previous '20x' label applied to all limits rather than just the session cap. While the 5 hour restriction is being removed in stages for verified subscribers to prevent fraud and abuse, the company said weekly usage limits remain in place. Anthony Overell, who leads product for Claude subscriptions, apologized for the earlier naming convention that led to user misunderstandings.

selectedTweets.text:
We’re renaming our Max plans: 

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max is still $100/month, and Ultra is still $200. If you’re a subscriber, there’s nothing you need to do.

We’re also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers. Newer accounts keep a temporary limit until they’re verified, which helps us prevent fraud and abuse. You'll get an email when it's removed.

Weekly limits remain unchanged. View our plans here:  https://t.co/niRpyGF5Me

selectedTweets.text:
I lead product for Claude subscriptions. Today we're renaming our Max plans, and I want to explain why.

When we launched our top plan in April 2025, it had a single limit: 5 hours. It gave you 20x Pro's limit, so we called it Max 20x. When we added weekly limits to Max 20x, we set them to 10x Pro's (the 5-hour limit stayed at 20x).

I get that some new users assumed 20x applied to both limits. We could have done better here, and I'm sorry.

The Ultra plan keeps the weekly limit (10x Pro), but we're removing the 5-hour limit so you can keep building without getting blocked mid-session. This starts today and rolls out in stages. To help prevent fraud and abuse, a temporary limit applies until we've verified your account. You'll get an email when your limit is removed.

We've got more cooking and can't wait to share it. Thanks for building with Claude 🙏
